name: Q 版特寫（第一代）
style_block:
- Medium-high detail: hair uses 8–12 broad overlapping locks with a few fine strand accents; accessories retain distinct segmented shapes and 2–3 shading tones, while clothing has minimal visible detail.
- Oversized rounded head and broad cheeks, with a tiny nose, short lower face, and elastic mouths; expressions strongly reshape eyelids, brows, and cheek contours.
- Tapered dark burgundy-to-near-black outer contours, roughly 0.5–1% of head width; finer coral-red lines define bangs, brows, noses, and hand creases, with especially thick upper lashes.
- Hair forms sweeping pointed ribbons with curved internal divisions, pale pink-gray shadow patches, and broad irregular white highlights; combine crisp shadow edges with softly blended transitions for a silky sheen.
- Large rounded irises have a deep navy upper band, saturated blue middle, luminous cyan lower crescent, a narrow oval pupil, and 2–3 prominent white highlights plus a few small reflected dots; heavy wedge-shaped upper lashes anchor the eyes.
- Skin stays luminous and pale with soft peach shading, diffuse rosy cheeks, and 3–5 short diagonal blush strokes per cheek; open mouths use a dark red rim, coral interior, and one broad lighter tongue shape.
- Tears and sweat are inflated glassy cyan shapes with blue outlines, white shine streaks, and bright rims; hearts and reaction symbols use bold colored outlines, thick white edging, and simple glossy highlights.
- Avoid: dense individual hair strands, intricate iris filigree, realistic skin texture, crosshatching, numerous clothing folds, and uniformly heavy black interior lines.
note: s1 當初沒有寫描述，2026-10-20 由 Codex 看 s1 的網格圖補寫（Codex 取名「亮澤糖彩表情」）

name: 更可愛的 Q 版
style_block:
- Super-deformed chibi proportions: big round head, round chubby face, small soft chin, puffy cheeks.
- Oversized glossy eyes with large sparkly highlights; tiny simple mouth and tiny nose.
- Hair simplified into a few big soft rounded clumps instead of many thin strands; fluffy rounded fox ears.
- Soft pastel palette, flat cel shading with at most one soft shadow tone, rosy oval blush on the cheeks.
- Clean, smooth, uniform lineart in a warm dark brown (not black), rounded line ends.
- Overall feel: soft, round, cute, sticker-like, very readable at small size.
note: 取自 s2 專案的畫風描述
